Hi Ava,

I signed up through the website and poked around the API docs - looks promising. We're evaluating Redwood for a semantic search + RAG use case across clinical notes and patient FAQs. A few quick details to help qualify: 

- Primary use case: retrieval-augmented generation for support and provider Q&A.
- Estimated volume: ~100k tokens/day initial, could ramp to ~500k in 6 months.
- Latency expectation: median sub-300ms for short queries, okay with slightly higher for longer RAG responses.
- Timeline: pilot in 6-8 weeks, production in Q3.

Can we schedule a 30-minute demo next week to see performance and integration options? I'm on Pacific time. My availability: Tue 3/23 10-12pm, Wed 3/24 2-4pm, or Fri 3/26 9-11am.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Ramos | Head of ML Engineering
HealthSync, Inc.

Hi Alex - great to meet you and thanks for the details. Happy to run a focused 30-min demo and tailor it to RAG + retrieval. A couple quick qualification questions so we make the session productive: 

1) Are you planning to host embeddings and vector store with us (Redwood) or self-host?
2) Expected QPS / concurrent users during peak? (ballpark is fine)
3) Any strict data residency/sla/policy requirements we should know about for the pilot?
4) Who else will join the demo from your side (PM, infra, security)?

Proposed slots based on your availability - pick one and I’ll send an invite: 
- Tue 3/23 10:30-11:00am PDT
- Wed 3/24 2:30-3:00pm PDT
- Fri 3/26 9:30-10:00am PDT

If none of those work, drop a couple other times and we’ll adapt. Also attaching a quick one-pager on our RAG pattern to review ahead.

Best,
Ava Chen

Hi Ava - thanks for the quick reply. Answers below: 

1) We'll likely host embeddings on Redwood for the pilot (we prefer managed for the first phase).
2) Peak: roughly 10-15 QPS expected initially, couple hundred concurrent users is a long-term goal.
3) Data residency: must remain in US regions; we'll need SOC2 and standard BAA language later, but not a blocker for pilot.
4) Attendees: myself, our PM (Maria Lopez), and one infra engineer (Ravi Patel).

Your Tue 3/23 10:30am slot works, but I have a conflicting all-hands - could we move 30 minutes later to 11:00-11:30am PDT instead? If that’s not possible, Wed 3/24 2:30pm works too.

Appreciate it,
Alex
